title: specy-road roadmap archive index
description: Ledger of archived roadmap subtrees. Toolkit-owned and validated against this bundled copy — never against <repo_root>/schemas/ — so adopters pick up new fields by upgrading the package rather than hand-editing a schema.

archive_id.description: Stable handle used by list/show/restore and as the chunk, bundle, and ref filename stem.

depth.description: shallow: nodes still readable as JSON under archive/chunks/. deep: bundled into archive/deep/ with only archive/refs/ left behind.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the archive operation.

node_keys.description: Every node_key in the archived subtree. validate_dependency_ids treats these as satisfied so live nodes may keep depending on archived work.

nodes_summary.description: Enough per-node identity to render the archive in the PM GUI without unpacking a deep bundle.

chunk.description: Repo-relative path to the archived chunk JSON. Present while depth is shallow; null once deep.

sources.description: Where each archived node sat before it moved. Restore replays these exactly — same chunk, same position — so a round trip leaves no diff, including when the subtree spanned several chunks or shared one with live nodes.

planning.description: Planning sheets moved out of planning/ into roadmap/archive/planning/<archive_id>/. Emptied when deep (the bundle carries them instead).

bundle.description: Deep archive capsule: one canonical JSON file holding the archived nodes and planning-sheet bodies. Deliberately uncompressed — git already compresses and deltas blobs, and text keeps archived work greppable and diffable. Canonical formatting makes the sha256 reproducible; it is verified before any restore unfolds it.

index.description: Position this node held in that chunk's nodes array.

origin.description: Repo-relative path the sheet came from, e.g. planning/M0.2_roadmap-ci_<key>.md. Restore puts it back here exactly.

stored.description: Repo-relative path inside the archive. Archived sheets live under roadmap/archive/planning/ rather than planning/archive/ because validate forbids any subdirectory under planning/.

git_provenance.description: Refs the archived work was delivered on, read from milestone_execution and git at archive time. Every field is best-effort: a repo with no rollup history archives fine with nulls.
